보고서

범위 프로젝트 2곳 · 부분 커버리지 · 구조 9/10 · 의미 4/9
fragmentEdits.newText: <section class="section" id="reportShell"><div class="tabs">

fragmentEdits.oldText: 구조 9/10 파일. 의미 4/9 파일. 없는 파일은 의미 분모에서 뺍니다.
fragmentEdits.newText: 구조와 의미는 다른 척도입니다. 분모는 같은 선택 페이지 총수이고, 평가됨·미확인·확인 불가를 모두 포함합니다.

fragmentEdits.oldText: 읽을 수 있는 파일만 대상
fragmentEdits.newText: 같은 페이지 총수 안의 의미 평가

fragmentEdits.oldText: <th>문서</th>
fragmentEdits.newText: <th>페이지 / 경로</th>

fragmentEdits.oldText: 선체 두께 측정은 경로가 비어 구조 커버리지에서 실패입니다. 의미 4/9의 9에는 넣지 않습니다.
fragmentEdits.newText: 선체 두께 측정은 경로가 비어 확인 불가입니다. 구조와 의미의 같은 분모에 남기고, 평가됨이 아닌 확인 불가로 둡니다.

fragmentEdits.oldText: 제안은 승인 전까지 오버레이입니다.
fragmentEdits.newText: 제안은 승인 전까지 문서를 바꾸지 않습니다.

fragmentEdits.newText: 병합 제안

초안 만들기는 별도 단계입니다. 승인이나 검토 완료가 아니며 게시하지 않습니다.

fragmentEdits.newText: data-action="draft:publish">검토한 초안 게시</button>

fragmentEdits.oldText: 진행 표시는 정비 개요의 진행 영역이 맡습니다. 이 창은 막대를 두지 않습니다.
fragmentEdits.newText: 범위와 깊이를 고르고 검사를 시작합니다. 구조는 읽기와 연결 목록이고, 의미는 주제와 신선도 후보입니다.

기억된 프로젝트와 공급자, 출처만 요약합니다. 백엔드 호출과 파일 쓰기는 없습니다.

notes: This is an unapproved design correction. Screenshots were not available here and were not visually verified. Root owns adapters and browser checks.

Maintenance: keep one summary in the page-header muted line, which runtime already overwrites. The duplicate report header count slot is removed; do not write another overall count. Keep #scanStatus visible for running and completed. Report h1 stays for the runtime selector but is a subheading; root may set aria-level 2. Set aria-selected on the active tab.

Coverage: structure and meaning stay distinct and share one selected-page denominator: assessed + unchecked + unavailable. Replace stale counts. Rebuild each body cell with page title and path on the first line and document context subordinate; keep .row-title and .muted on the first two summary cards, plus project, structure, and meaning columns.
Finding: keep evidence article.card, proposal article.section, p.notice, and #findingDecision. Draft creation stays a separate next step and must not mean approved, reviewed, or published.

Draft: avoid a second title against .page-header h1 and a second status title. Do not remove action buttons appended inside #draftState. Keep replace, reject, and explicit publish distinct; a stale base still blocks publish.

Scan: structural depth disables or hides #scanBudget and shows the inline no-AI note; semantic enables it. Root may set data-scan-depth. Engine may remove max; do not add currency or a page cap. Engine overwrites the first p.small with the live budget explanation. Progress stays in maintenance #scanStatus.

Archive and trash: engine-built rows place metadata left and actions in .row or .row-end at the right, wrapping at 390px. Restore labels are 서재로 복원 or 보관함으로 복원, never 보관함로. Purge copy, full version and note effect, missing references, backup exclusion, and cancel autofocus stay unchanged. Purge or danger never uses primary blue.

Import: #importBase remains inside #importBaseWrap, hidden for newdoc and shown for newversion. Root sets data-import-kind and data-upload-state. Idle makes Start primary, paused makes Resume primary while disabled Start is not blue, completed makes Open primary. Keep every action present. Show the immutable captured target on resume and do not recapture. Dialog close, including Escape, refreshes the Home paused or running import entry. #importStatus and #importProgress stay live.

Create: fill empty #createScopeSummary from H.state.projectId and the current source mode, adding a sample-provider label only when that mode is selected. create:start prepares a draft; publish stays in draft review.

notes: This is an unapproved design correction. Screenshots were not available here and were not visually verified. Root owns adapters and browser checks.

Maintenance: keep one summary in the page-header muted line, which runtime already overwrites. The duplicate report header count slot is removed; do not write another overall count. Keep #scanStatus visible for running and completed. Report h1 stays for the runtime selector but is a subheading; root may set aria-level 2. Set aria-selected on the active tab.

Coverage: structure and meaning stay distinct and share one selected-page denominator: assessed + unchecked + unavailable. Replace stale counts. Rebuild each body cell with page title and path on the first line and document context subordinate; keep .row-title and .muted on the first two summary cards, plus project, structure, and meaning columns.
Finding: keep evidence article.card, proposal article.section, p.notice, and #findingDecision. Draft creation stays a separate next step and must not mean approved, reviewed, or published.

Draft: avoid a second title against .page-header h1 and a second status title. Do not remove action buttons appended inside #draftState. Keep replace, reject, and explicit publish distinct; a stale base still blocks publish.

Scan: structural depth disables or hides #scanBudget and shows the inline no-AI note; semantic enables it. Root may set data-scan-depth. Engine may remove max; do not add currency or a page cap. Engine overwrites the first p.small with the live budget explanation. Progress stays in maintenance #scanStatus.

Archive and trash: engine-built rows place metadata left and actions in .row or .row-end at the right, wrapping at 390px. Restore labels are 서재로 복원 or 보관함으로 복원, never 보관함로. Purge copy, full version and note effect, missing references, backup exclusion, and cancel autofocus stay unchanged. Purge or danger never uses primary blue.

Import: #importBase remains inside #importBaseWrap, hidden for newdoc and shown for newversion. Root sets data-import-kind and data-upload-state. Idle makes Start primary, paused makes Resume primary while disabled Start is not blue, completed makes Open primary. Keep every action present. Show the immutable captured target on resume and do not recapture. Dialog close, including Escape, refreshes the Home paused or running import entry. #importStatus and #importProgress stay live.

Create: fill empty #createScopeSummary from H.state.projectId and the current source mode, adding a sample-provider label only when that mode is selected. create:start prepares a draft; publish stays in draft review.
